title: Regulator-approved warnings on licensed Taiwanese health foods (健康食品警語)

citation.reference: 健康食品資料集 · 衛生福利部食品藥物管理署 · data.gov.tw dataset 6951
citation.licence: 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版 (Taiwan Open Government Data Licence v1)
citation.criteriaSource: 警語 and 注意事項 fields of each licensed product

coverage.note: Every licensed health food carries its own approved 警語. Rather than restating them, these rules match on terms appearing in that text and quote the product's own wording onto the finding. Three condition pairings are encoded; the register holds 464 products whose warnings travel with them regardless.

whyThisExists: Prescriptions are visible to a clinician. What a neighbour recommended is not. 紅麴 (red yeast rice) is the clearest case: 54 licensed products, whose approved warning states that combining them with statins or fibrates risks liver and kidney injury, that people with liver disease should not take them at all, and that they are unsuitable alongside anticoagulants. None of that reaches a three-minute consultation unless somebody says it out loud.

rules.verbatim: This product's regulator-approved warning names liver disease among the conditions for which it should not be taken, and the person's record includes chronic liver disease.
rules.limits: Matched on terms appearing in the approved warning text, not on a clinical assessment of this person. The warning is quoted in full on the finding so a pharmacist or physician reads the regulator's wording rather than ours.

rules.verbatim: This product's regulator-approved warning states it is unsuitable for people taking medicines with anticoagulant action, and an anticoagulant is present in the list.
rules.limits: The warning refers to medicines with anticoagulant action, Chinese or Western. Only the Western anticoagulant classes present in the register are matched here; herbal preparations are not.

rules.verbatim: This product's regulator-approved warning names gastrointestinal conditions among those for which it should not be taken, and the person's record includes peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding.
rules.limits: Matched on terms in the approved warning text, not on a clinical assessment.

notEncoded.unlicensed_supplements: 健康食品 is a licensed category. Most of what a family actually buys — fish oil from a warehouse store, capsules from a neighbour — carries no licence and appears in no register, so no warning exists to match. Those items stay in the record as unresolved and are counted against coverage. The gap is the product's reason for existing, not a defect to paper over.
